claims.claim: 标记同步以相邻标记之间的相对时间位置对应动画。
claims.observed_content: 页面以时间线标记间的相对播放位置解释同步。
claims.conditions: 动画与标记需要满足组及名称条件；不据此声称复现内部匹配。
claims.article_section: 先对应这一段步态，再找另一个片段的时间

claims.claim: 同组、同名标记；仅全组共有标记参与；无匹配标记回退长度同步。
claims.observed_content: 正文要求组名与标记名匹配；示例缺少 Right Foot Down 时该标记被忽略，并说明无匹配时的长度回退。
claims.conditions: 缺少一种标记不推出完全回退，不推断最少标记数、重复名称或循环跨界实现。
claims.article_section: 加了标记，还要检查哪些标记真的参与

original_reasoning.conditions: Hypothetical adjacent nonzero intervals with corresponding semantics; no wrap/repeated-marker matching.
original_reasoning.interpretation: Time correspondence does not constrain world-space contact. Semantic placement and actual assets require project checks.

contact_phase_clarification.basis: Original finite counterexample using the article’s hypothetical marker times, plus explicit hypothetical contact annotations. Not an asset observation or engine result.
contact_phase_clarification.reasoning: A at 0.45 s and B at 0.3 s have equal inter-marker progress. If A left-foot lift-off is 0.75 s and B left-foot lift-off is 0.25 s with right touchdown at 0.5 s, equal progress does not determine equal support state. Touchdown endpoints do not encode lift-off.
contact_phase_clarification.reader_method: Compare left/right contact intervals or touchdown/lift-off events under the chosen time mapping; decide which state differences fit the intended blend before evaluating world-space contact.
contact_phase_clarification.source_recheck: Epic UE 5.6 Sync Groups official page reread 2026-11-11; marker/common-name/fallback claims remain unchanged.
